mapper.sql: select r.id, r.activity_id, r.signup_id, r.checkin_record_id, r.volunteer_user_id, r.service_date, r.start_time, r.end_time, r.service_minutes, r.status, r.confirm_user_id, r.confirm_time, r.adjust_reason, r.create_by, r.create_time, r.update_by, r.update_time, r.remark, a.title as activity_title, a.service_location, s.real_name as volunteer_real_name, s.phone as volunteer_phone, s.organization as volunteer_organization from vol_service_record r left join vol_activity a on a.id = r.activity_id left join vol_activity_signup s on s.id = r.signup_id
mapper.select: select ifnull(sum(service_minutes), 0) from vol_service_record where volunteer_user_id = #{volunteerUserId} and status = 1
